records.label: Dewaele et al. (2008), PAW LDA, static lattice, with semicore
records.note: The hcp-Fe LDA Table VI parameterization disagrees with the thick LDA Figure 4 path assigned to with-semicore PAW beyond digitization and printed-precision bounds. The follow-up finds agreement with the thin path instead (static maximum difference 0.00244 A3/atom; 298 K 0.00138 A3/atom). The source's table/semicore identity remains unresolved; diagnostic only, not recommended for predictions or pressure calibration. See docs/literature-reproductions/dewaele-2008-metals.md#follow-up-hcp-fe-lda-curve-identity.
